title: Training-seed variability of the two final retrieval configurations
descriptive_only: Seed 42 remains the released model. Other seeds describe variability only. No seed or metric is selected on test.
verification_scope: Fresh file hashes, configuration and checkpoint metadata, checkpoint selection, stopping rules, query alignment, metric recomputation and seed-42 reference agreement. Actual checkpoint bytes were not checked by this analysis.
units: Recall@k, Hit@10, mAP and nDCG in percent. MRR as a fraction. Paired differences and SD of percentage metrics in percentage points. Across-seed SD uses denominator n - 1.

bootstrap.unit: article groups from all recorded image pairs
